purpose: Audit the exact continuous graph-edge-to-spline trajectory geometry for the three authorized C08 development worlds before any LiDAR, M1D inference or online topology replay.

approval.scope: One Gate-4 zero-ray geometry contract on exactly three C08 worlds using explicit graph-node connectors no longer than 0.5m, followed by perception-mesh clearance audit and exact route/frame recount. No C09/C10, LiDAR, inference, graph construction or M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 批准 after receiving the S01 node_0015 0.361167m offset evidence, options, costs and the recommended <=0.5m explicit connector contract; then replied 继续 during implementation.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of sealed generated graph, spline and native perception-mesh assets; upstream source is not redistributed.

sampling.rule: For each world, construct a deterministic doubled-edge Euler route carrying edge identity; traverse each edge once per direction using explicit <=0.5m node-to-spline connectors and its associated spline subarc; sample at route arcs 0,2,4,... strictly before each independent endpoint. This geometry run writes poses only and casts zero LiDAR rays.

teacher.source: Sealed C08 graph edge IDs, node xyz, tunnel_ids and corresponding spline points are geometry provenance only; no semantic teacher is generated in this run.
teacher.valid_mask: Every graph edge must reference exactly one existing spline; connector <=0.5m; every connector sample at <=0.05m spacing must have unsigned distance >=0.8m from the frozen perception-mesh surface.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: The resulting trajectory contract is shared unchanged by later B0, frozen M1D and GT-oracle replay; this run does not execute any of them.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only three predeclared train-split C08 assets are opened. C09 identities are listed for future isolation but files are not read; all C10 and M-TARE benchmark assets remain forbidden. Historical prototype trajectories and NPZ files are excluded.

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU/Open3D only; three existing meshes, connector closest-surface queries and four scientific previews; zero GPU and zero raycast.
